brief: Two separate pairs of bases, the pairs joined to each other only with side connectors.

requirements.requirement: Two pairs of bases (four bases in all)
requirements.evidence: piece:0,0,0, piece:1,0,0 (pair A) and piece:0,1,0, piece:1,1,0 (pair B).

requirements.requirement: The two bases of each pair are joined to each other
The pairs are joined to each other only with side connectors
requirements.evidence: The three walls between the pairs each have one side connector: connector:0#0,0|0,1, connector:0#0,1|1,0 and connector:0#1,0|1,1. No joint bolts are on those walls. lockJoints was left out on purpose, so check_build warns LOOSE_BODY for the bolts between the pairs.

finish.summary:
Four full bases sit in a 2×2 diamond shape on one level. Pair A is (0,0) and (1,0), held together by joint bolt jointBolt:0#0,0#0. Pair B is (0,1) and (1,1), held together by jointBolt:0#0,1#0. The two pairs meet along three walls, and each of those walls has only a single side connector: (0,0)|(0,1), (0,1)|(1,0) and (1,0)|(1,1). No joint bolts are fitted between the pairs. I checked this: after bolting, the remaining bolt offers showed only the two walls inside the pairs had been filled.

I added end caps to all open faces (capOpenFaces). I left out the lockJoints step on purpose, because it would put bolts between the pairs and break the brief. So check_build gives one LOOSE_BODY warning: as far as joint bolts go, pair B is loose from pair A. That's expected here, since only the connectors hold the pairs together. No rules are broken and the parts don't collide.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

lines.key: pvc-section-single  (cut 9 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))
lines.label: pvc-section-single (cut 9 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes
